cars.name: Aston Martin DB12 Volante
cars.character: A convertible grand tourer: roof down along the water, roof up and quiet for the motorway home.
cars.cabin: Two proper front seats and occasional rear seats; luggage space suits a couple travelling light.

cars.name: Ferrari Roma Spider
cars.character: A front-engined V8 with a fabric roof, as happy idling through a harbour town as climbing a corniche.
cars.cabin: Built around two people, with small rear seats best used for bags.

cars.name: Bentley Continental GT
cars.character: All-wheel drive, a deeply finished cabin and long-distance calm: made for crossing mountains in comfort.
cars.cabin: Four seats and a boot that takes a week's luggage for two.

cars.name: Porsche 911 Targa 4
cars.character: Precise, compact and all-wheel drive, with an open roof panel for the coast road and composure on the pass.
cars.cabin: A driver's car for two, with small rear seats and a front luggage compartment.

cars.name: Range Rover
cars.character: A quiet, high-riding cabin for families, luggage and changeable weather.
cars.cabin: Five full seats and generous luggage space; a composed choice on narrow or unsealed roads.

cars.name: Land Rover Defender 110
cars.character: Upright, robust and at ease on single-track roads, gravel and weather that changes by the hour.
cars.cabin: Five seats (some versions seat more) and room for boots, bags and a picnic.
